bugs.bug: _parseCommand reports an unknown option before dispatching, so a better error such as an unknown command (or the command:* event for suggestions) is masked by the unknown-option error
bugs.example: index.js: `if (parsed.unknown.length > 0) this.unknownOption(...)` runs unconditionally before the dispatch, so a misspelled subcommand given with an option reports 'unknown option' instead of 'unknown command'
